plugins.name: project-development-skills
plugins.description: Focused development workflows for implementation, decisions, debugging, verification, documentation, UI, and deployment. Use the guidance that fits the task.
defaultPrompts: Use the project-development skill that fits this task; start with project-development-mindset when the work needs general coordination.
Compare practical options with brainstorm-first when a decision is requested, or implement an already selected approach with the relevant skill.
Complete this project change with proportionate checks and existing authorization. Use run-reviewable-subtask-loop only when explicitly requested or accepted.

plugins.name: laravel-app-skills
plugins.description: Laravel 11/12 and Laravel 13 guidance selected by installed or target framework version, with project-specific frontend and command conventions.
defaultPrompts: Inspect the installed or target laravel/framework major, then use exactly one matching Laravel guideline skill for this project task.
Apply laravel-app-skills to review this repository without loading both Laravel version skills.
